senses.gloss: f. (compound of דִּי, כְּ a. מָא, v. כְּמָא a. דְּ־) appearance, resemblance, the like of.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:1:10">Y. M. Kat. III, 81ᵈ</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00764"><he>דִּכְוָות־</he></cite>. With suffix of pers. pronoun: <he>דִּכְמִי</he>, <he>דִּכְמֵיה</he>, <he>דִּכְמוֹהִי</he> &c.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 1:8">Targ. Job I, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 2:3">II, 3</cite>; a. e.—Constr. <cite ref="D00781"><he>דִּכְמַת</he></cite>, with suffix <he>דִּכְמָתִי</he> &c.
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 18:3">Targ. II Chr. XVIII, 3</cite> ed. Lag.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 12:3">Targ. Job XII, 3</cite>; a. fr.—*<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 73:15">Targ. Ps. LXXIII, 15</cite> <he>דִּכְמָתְהוֹן</he> (ed. Lag. <he>דמכמתהון</he>), v. <cite ref="K00824"><he>כְּמָת־</he></cite>.
